rationale_overall: Q3 2024 was a buildup quarter, not a peak/crest quarter, for every wave the profile names: AI incumbents (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA/AMD) kept posting clean growth (NVDA's July quarter revenue +122% YoY), defense (ITA/LMT/GD/AVAV) is at the 4-ticker wave-bucket cap on strong Q3 prints, and existing space/nuclear/quantum/demographics holdings (RKLB, LUNR, CCJ, SMR, IONQ, ISRG) all showed continued execution with no thesis breach, so none are removed. The three adds sharpen exposure to the declared next waves without crowding any bucket past the 4-ticker guardrail: OKLO adds a purer-play nuclear-SMR name behind CCJ/SMR on a 93%-larger LOI pipeline; ASTS adds a third space-economy name behind RKLB/LUNR on its first satellite launch and AT&T/Verizon agreements; SYM gives robotics its first name beyond ROK on a genuine revenue inflection. Watchlist grows from 18 to 21 tickers, still under the 24 cap.
